characters.summary: Varda is the Queen of the Valar, dwelling in Valinor above Ilmen. She wields supreme light and power, shaping the stars and hearing all sounds made within Eä, and her name is invoked as a supreme defense against darkness.

techniques: Creation and placement of new stars

limitations: Bound by Eru Ilúvatar's decrees regarding direct physical intervention in Middle-earth

sources.supports: Varda's role as Queen of the Valar, her creation of the stars, and her association with light and sound.

feats.claim: Rekindled the greatest stars in the heavens to prepare for the coming of the Elves.
Can hear all voices, cries, and sounds from east to west of Arda.

campaignTags.claim: Varda exists as a celestial power above the spheres of the world.

unknowns: Extent of direct physical combat abilities outside of cosmic creation and divine light is unquantified.

characters.continuity: The Lord of the Rings / The Silmarillion
characters.summary: The Witch-king is the Lord of the Nazgûl, wielding terrifying psychological dread, dark sorcery, and a flaming sword or morgul blade. He relies on spectral terror, shadow-steeds, and undead resilience to break his foes.

techniques: Aura of the Black Breath (fear and despair)

mechanisms: Undead spectral form resistant to normal mortal weapons
Prophetic protection from death by ordinary men

weaknesses: Vulnerable to blades forged with spells against Angmar (such as Westernesse daggers)
Destruction by those possessing specific ancestry or destiny (Eowyn and Merry)
limitations: Power wanes in daylight or under direct sunlight without dark clouds
Bound to the will of Sauron via the One Ring

sources.supports: History, abilities, weapons, and defeat of the Witch-king of Angmar.

feats.claim: Stabbed Frodo Baggins with a Morgul blade on Weathertop.
Used the spell Grond-amplified sorcery to shatter the great gates of Minas Tirith.
Defeated King Earnur of Gondor and forced him to flee.
feats.citation: The Appendices of The Lord of the Rings

notableResults.note: Ambushed Frodo on Weathertop and inflicted a near-fatal wound with a Morgul blade.
Destroyed after Merry disrupted his invulnerability with a Barrow-blade and Éowyn delivered the fatal strike.

campaignTags.claim: Rides a winged fell beast in battle.
Fights while riding a winged fell beast.
Wields dark sorcery, including the spell that shattered the gates of Minas Tirith.
Wields a sword that can be filled with fire.

unknowns: Exact mechanics of the prophecy regarding his death ('not by the hand of man will he fall').

characters.summary: Yavanna is the Valier of Earth and growth, mother of all things that grow in Arda. She commands immense nature magic, bringing flora and forests to life and creating the Ents to protect her trees.

techniques: Singing trees and living plants into rapid growth

mechanisms: Divine resilience as one of the Valar
Protection by Oromë and the other Valar

limitations: Cannot restore the Two Trees of Valinor once their light was drained by Ungoliant without the light of the Silmarils.

sources.supports: Yavanna's identity as the Vala of Earth, creator of plants, and mother of the Ents.

feats.claim: Created the Two Trees of Valinor (Telperion and Laurelin) through her song.
feats.citation: The Silmarillion, Of the Beginning of Time

feats.claim: Conceived the Ents and the Eagles to guard her beloved creations against the depravations of Aulë and Morgoth.
feats.citation: The Silmarillion, Of Aulë and Yavanna

campaignTags.claim: Uses divine songs and powers to create and nurture plant life.

unknowns: Specific combat engagements or offensive spellcasting outside of creation and life-giving.
